subject: DI01000091

body.en:
Understand the idea

Formatting should make a document readable and consistent,not merely colourful.

Explanation and application

  • Font family,size,colour,bold/italic/underline and effects change character appearance.Use restrained typography and readable contrast.
  • Paragraph alignment,indents,line spacing,space before/after and bullets/numbering affect whole paragraphs.Use styles for headings rather than repeated manual formatting.
  • WordArt is decorative text;Drop Cap enlarges an initial letter.Neither replaces a real heading structure or improves every document.
  • Insert Symbol supplies special characters;Equation creates structured mathematics such as V=IR.Use the appropriate tool instead of misaligned spaces.
  • Menus/features differ between desktop,web and mobile versions.Record the application/version used and choose teacher-approved equivalents if a feature is unavailable.
Does displayed rounding change every stored value?

Not necessarily.Use an explicit rounding formula when the calculation requires it.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Formatting documentને readable/consistent બનાવે,ફક્ત colourful નહિ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Font family,size,colour,bold/italic/underline/effects charactersનો દેખાવ બદલે છે.Readable contrast તથા restrained typography લો.
  • Alignment,indents,line spacing,before/after spacing તથા bullets/numbering આખા paragraphને અસર કરે છે.Headings માટે styles લો.
  • WordArt decorative text છે;Drop Cap શરૂઆતનો letter મોટો કરે છે.બંને real heading structureનો વિકલ્પ નથી.
  • Symbol special characters આપે છે;Equation V=IR જેવી structured mathematics બનાવે છે.Misaligned spacesને બદલે યોગ્ય tool લો.
  • Desktop,web/mobileમાં features જુદાં હોય છે.Application/version લખો;feature ન હોય તો teacher-approved equivalent લો.
Display Roundingથી Stored Value બદલાય?

જરૂરી નહિ.Calculationમાં જોઈએ તો explicit rounding formula લો.

h.gu: Tables તથા Illustrations માહિતી સ્પષ્ટ કરે

body.en:
Understand the idea

Select data structure first,then insert a table,picture,shape,SmartArt or chart that fits the purpose.

Explanation and application

  • Add/delete rows and columns intentionally;merge combines cells and split divides a selected cell.Keep headers clear and avoid destroying data while restructuring.
  • Use picture wrapping,size and alignment deliberately;preserve aspect ratio unless distortion is intentional.Add useful alternative text.
  • Shapes draw simple objects;SmartArt represents relationships/processes;charts display data.Do not treat a decorative diagram as measured evidence.
  • In desktop Word,a table Formula such as =SUM(ABOVE) creates a field,not an automatically maintained Excel worksheet.Update/recalculate fields after edits and inspect the range.
  • Word table references and formula field features differ from spreadsheet references;do not assume copied Word formulas follow Excel relative-address rules.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

પહેલાં data structure પસંદ કરો,પછી purpose મુજબ table,picture,shape,SmartArt/chart ઉમેરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Rows/columns જાણીને ઉમેરો/દૂર કરો.Merge cells combine કરે છે;split selected cell divide કરે છે.Headers clear રાખો તથા data ન ગુમાવો.
  • Picture wrapping,size/alignment વિચારીને લો.Intentional distortion સિવાય aspect ratio જાળવો;useful alt text આપો.
  • Shapes simple objects,SmartArt relationships/processes તથા charts data બતાવે છે.Decorative diagramને measured evidence ન માનો.
  • Desktop Wordમાં =SUM(ABOVE) table Formula field બનાવે છે,Excel worksheet નહિ.Edit પછી fields update/recalculate કરીને range તપાસો.
  • Word table references/formula fields spreadsheetથી જુદાં છે.Copied Word formulas Excel relative-address rules અનુસરે એવું ન માનો.

h.en: A Word table calculation is a field

body.en:
Understand the idea

Use the provided Word practice file to observe calculation and update behaviour in your actual desktop application.

Explanation and application

  • With amounts100and50above a total cell,=SUM(ABOVE) should show150after the field is evaluated.
  • On supported desktop Word,use the table Formula function to insert the field.Change a source amount and explicitly update the field;inspect the new value.
  • If a web/mobile edition lacks the feature,record that limitation and use the assigned desktop environment rather than typing a fake calculated result.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Provided Word practice fileથી actual desktop applicationમાં calculation/update behaviour જુઓ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Total cellની ઉપર100તથા50હોય તો =SUM(ABOVE) evaluate થયા પછી150થવું જોઈએ.
  • Supported desktop Wordમાં table Formulaથી field ઉમેરો.Source amount બદલી field explicitly update કરીને new value તપાસો.
  • Web/mobileમાં feature ન હોય તો limitation લખીને assigned desktop environment લો.Fake calculated result type ન કરો.

h.en: Page setup is part of the document

body.en:
Understand the idea

Paper size,orientation,margins and page elements determine how a document prints or exports.

Explanation and application

  • Set page size and margins before fine layout;use page breaks rather than repeated blank lines to force a new page.
  • Headers/footers hold repeated information such as title,date and page number.Check first-page and section behaviour.
  • Preview the full document for clipped tables,orphan headings,unexpected blank pages and incorrect numbering before PDF/print.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Paper size,orientation,margins/page elements print/export નક્કી કરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Fine layout પહેલાં page size/margins સેટ કરો.New page માટે repeated blank linesને બદલે page break લો.
  • Headers/footers title,date/page number જેવી repeated માહિતી રાખે છે.First-page તથા section behaviour તપાસો.
  • PDF/print પહેલાં clipped tables,orphan headings,blank pages તથા numbering માટે આખું document preview કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Spelling and grammar suggestions are aids;the writer remains responsible for meaning,names and technical accuracy.

Explanation and application

  • Set the intended proofing language and examine context before accepting suggestions,especially Gujarati/English technical terms.
  • Use Grammarly only through an approved legitimate installation/account path;features and integrations depend on version/policy.
  • Before sending text to a cloud review tool,remove private student/customer information and follow institutional consent/confidentiality rules.
  • Compare the corrected text with the original and manually verify formulas,units,addresses and names.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Spelling/grammar suggestions મદદરૂપ છે;meaning,names/technical accuracyની જવાબદારી writerની છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Intended proofing language સેટ કરો;ખાસ કરીને Gujarati/English technical termsમાં suggestion context જુઓ.
  • Grammarly ફક્ત approved legitimate installation/accountથી લો.Features/integrations version/policy મુજબ હોય છે.
  • Cloud review toolમાં text મોકલતાં પહેલાં private student/customer information દૂર કરો તથા institutional consent/confidentiality rules પાળો.
  • Corrected/original text compare કરીને formulas,units,addresses/names manually verify કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Mail merge combines a main document with a structured recipient data source to create personalised copies.

Explanation and application

  • Prepare a clean table with one header row and one recipient per row;keep field names stable and avoid blank/duplicate records.
  • Connect the source,insert merge fields such as Industry and Contact,then preview first,last and selected middle records.
  • Filter/sort only when intended;verify the record count and field mapping before finishing to a new document or approved print workflow.
  • The practical asks for10industries.Use10clearly fictional training records first;do not send real invitations or email without owner approval.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Mail merge main document તથા structured recipient data sourceથી personalised copies બનાવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • એક header row તથા recipient દીઠ એક rowનું clean table બનાવો.Field names stable રાખો;blank/duplicate records ટાળો.
  • Source connect કરીને Industry/Contact જેવા merge fields ઉમેરો;first,last તથા middle records preview કરો.
  • Intended હોય ત્યારે જ filter/sort કરો.Finish પહેલાં record count તથા field mapping verify કરો.
  • Practicalમાં10industries છે.પહેલાં10clearly fictional training records લો;owner approval વગર real invitations/email ન મોકલો.

h.en: Google Docs and the syllabus wording

body.en:
Understand the idea

The phrase Google Docs sheet is ambiguous;learn document creation/sharing here and spreadsheet creation in2.10.

Explanation and application

  • Create a named document,enter structured content,format headings and verify the saved cloud version.
  • Share a training document with the required role and test access;comments/suggesting edits are not the same as editing the final text directly.
  • Check permissions before downloading/exporting and keep a clearly named editable source alongside any required PDF.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Google Docs sheet wording ambiguous છે;અહીં document creation/sharing તથા2.10માં spreadsheet શીખીએ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Named document બનાવો,structured content/headings આપો તથા saved cloud version verify કરો.
  • Required roleથી training document share કરીને access test કરો.Comments/suggestions final text direct edit કરતાં જુદાં છે.
  • Download/export પહેલાં permissions તપાસો.Required PDF સાથે clearly named editable source રાખો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A worksheet organises values in rows/columns;an address identifies a location,not its meaning.

Explanation and application

  • A1 means column A,row1;A1:C4 is a range.A workbook can contain several worksheets.
  • Numbers,text,logical values and dates need deliberate handling.A displayed date may be backed by a serial number under the workbook date system.
  • Number formatting changes display,not necessarily the stored value;rounding displayed decimals does not automatically round later calculations.
  • Keep units in headers and consistent per column;avoid mixing currency text with numbers used in arithmetic.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Worksheet rows/columnsમાં values ગોઠવે છે.Address location છે,meaning નહિ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • A1 એટલે column A,row1;A1:C4 range છે.Workbookમાં અનેક worksheets હોઈ શકે.
  • Numbers,text,logical values/dates વિચારીને લો.Displayed date પાછળ workbook date systemનો serial number હોઈ શકે.
  • Number formatting display બદલે છે,stored value જરૂરી નહિ.Display decimals round કરવાથી later calculations આપોઆપ round નથી થતી.
  • Headersમાં units તથા columnમાં consistency રાખો.Arithmeticના numbers સાથે currency text ભેળવશો નહિ.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A formula begins with =;references make the calculation reusable when data changes.

Explanation and application

  • Use parentheses to state intended precedence:=2+3*4 gives14,while =(2+3)*4 gives20.
  • Relative A1 shifts when copied;absolute $A$1 stays fixed;$A1 and A$1 lock only one dimension.In a rate calculation use an absolute rate cell.
  • Practise SUM,AVERAGE,MIN,MAX,COUNT,COUNTA,IF,ROUND,COUNTIF and SUMIF on a labelled range;explain each argument and the treatment of blanks/text.
  • Example marks70,80,90 sum to240 and average80.These are synthetic teaching values,not student records.
  • Check division by zero,text-as-number errors,formula range omissions and locale argument separators before trusting the result.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Formula =થી શરૂ થાય છે;referencesથી data બદલાતાં calculation reusable બને છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Intended precedence માટે parentheses લો:=2+3*4થી14 તથા =(2+3)*4થી20 મળે છે.
  • Relative A1 copyએ shift થાય છે;absolute $A$1 fixed રહે છે;$A1 તથા A$1 એક dimension lock કરે છે.Rate calculationમાં absolute rate cell લો.
  • Labelled range ઉપર SUM,AVERAGE,MIN,MAX,COUNT,COUNTA,IF,ROUND,COUNTIF/SUMIF શીખો.Arguments તથા blanks/textનું handling સમજાવો.
  • Example marks70,80,90નો sum240 તથા average80 છે.આ synthetic teaching values છે,student records નહિ.
  • Result માનતાં પહેલાં zero division,text-as-number errors,range omissions તથા locale separators તપાસો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Charts answer a question;they must not distort scale or hide the data assumptions.

Explanation and application

  • Column/bar compares categories;line shows ordered trends;XY scatter relates numeric x and y;pie shows suitable nonnegative parts of a whole.
  • Area charts emphasise magnitude over an ordered axis;too many overlapping series can obscure information.
  • Choose a labelled source range,axis units,title and legend;avoid decorative3D effects when the syllabus asks2D charts.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Chart પ્રશ્નનો જવાબ આપે;scale distort કે assumptions hide ન કરે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Column/bar categories compare કરે;line ordered trend,XY scatter numeric x/y relationship તથા pie suitable nonnegative parts બતાવે છે.
  • Area charts ordered axis ઉપર magnitude બતાવે છે;વધુ overlapping seriesથી માહિતી છુપાઈ શકે.
  • Labelled source range,axis units,title/legend લો.Syllabus2D માંગે ત્યારે decorative3D effects ટાળો.

h.en: Functions with a tiny synthetic range

body.en:
Understand the idea

Assume A2:A5contains2,4,4,10and A6contains the text note.These are training values.

Explanation and application

  • SUM(A2:A5)=20;AVERAGE(A2:A5)=5;MIN=2;MAX=10.Use the range explicitly with each function.
  • COUNT(A2:A6)=4counts numeric cells;COUNTA(A2:A6)=5counts nonempty cells here.
  • COUNTIF(A2:A5,">=4")=3;SUMIF(A2:A5,">=4")=18.Criteria belong in the criteria argument,not in the cell address.
  • ROUND(10/3,2)=3.33actually rounds the formula value;formatting to2decimal places alone only changes display.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

A2:A5માં2,4,4,10તથા A6માં text note માનો.આ training values છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • SUM(A2:A5)=20;AVERAGE(A2:A5)=5;MIN=2;MAX=10છે.દરેક functionમાં range explicitly લો.
  • COUNT(A2:A6)=4numeric cells ગણે છે;અહીં COUNTA(A2:A6)=5nonempty cells ગણે છે.
  • COUNTIF(A2:A5,">=4")=3;SUMIF(A2:A5,">=4")=18છે.Criteria criteria argumentમાં આવે છે,cell addressમાં નહિ.
  • ROUND(10/3,2)=3.33formula valueને round કરે છે.ફક્ત2decimal places formatting display જ બદલે છે.

h.en: Print only the intended worksheet area
h.gu: ફક્ત Intended Worksheet Area Print કરો

body.en:
Understand the idea

Print setup is separate from cell formatting and must be checked in preview.

Explanation and application

  • Define print area,paper size,orientation,margins and sensible scaling;do not shrink a large sheet until text becomes unreadable.
  • Set header/footer and page numbering;repeat header rows across pages when appropriate.
  • Inspect page breaks,clipped columns and blank extra pages;export PDF or print only after confirming the output.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Print setup cell formattingથી જુદું છે;previewમાં તપાસવું પડે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Print area,paper size,orientation,margins તથા sensible scaling લો.Unreadable text થાય એટલું shrink ન કરો.
  • Header/footer,page numbering તથા યોગ્ય હોય તો repeated header rows સેટ કરો.
  • Page breaks,clipped columns તથા extra blank pages તપાસો.Output confirm પછી જ PDF/print લો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Create a named cloud spreadsheet and verify both data correctness and access control.

Explanation and application

  • Enter headers/data,use formulas and choose a suitable chart;do not assume every Excel feature transfers identically.
  • Test imported/exported formulas,formats and print settings;regional date/number conventions may matter.
  • Share with least privilege,review version history and use only approved sample data during collaborative practice.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Named cloud spreadsheet બનાવી data correctness તથા access control બંને verify કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Headers/data,formulas તથા suitable chart લો.દરેક Excel feature identically transfer થાય એવું ન માનો.
  • Import/export પછી formulas,formats તથા print settings test કરો.Regional date/number conventions મહત્વનાં છે.
  • Least privilegeથી share કરો,version history જુઓ તથા collaborative practiceમાં approved sample data જ લો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Choose slide layout and theme to support the audience and message.

Explanation and application

  • Create slides using layouts for title/content;place text in suitable placeholders or text boxes instead of randomly positioned fragments.
  • Use consistent fonts,colours,background and restrained effects;keep contrast and type size readable at presentation distance.
  • Insert tables/charts only when they support the point;keep labels and units clear.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Audience/message મુજબ slide layout તથા theme પસંદ કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Title/content માટે layouts લો.Suitable placeholders/text boxesમાં text રાખો,random fragments નહિ.
  • Consistent fonts,colours,background તથા restrained effects લો.Presentation distanceએ contrast/type readable રાખો.
  • Pointને support કરે ત્યારે જ tables/charts ઉમેરો.Labels/units clear રાખો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Selection controls which object an operation affects;confirm the target before deletion or formatting.

Explanation and application

  • Move changes position;copy makes a separate instance;delete removes the selected object.Use Undo after an unintended change.
  • Resize pictures with aspect ratio preserved when appropriate;align/distribute related objects for consistent spacing.
  • Bring forward/send backward changes stacking order;grouping allows related objects to move together without merging their contents.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Selectionથી operation કયા objectને અસર કરે તે નક્કી થાય છે.Delete/format પહેલાં target confirm કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Move position બદલે છે;copy separate instance બનાવે છે;delete selected object દૂર કરે છે.Unintended changeમાં Undo લો.
  • યોગ્ય હોય ત્યારે picture aspect ratio જાળવી resize કરો.Related objects align/distribute કરો.
  • Bring forward/send backward stacking બદલે છે.Groupingથી contents merge કર્યા વગર objects સાથે move થાય છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Use drawing tools and styles to clarify relationships while respecting image rights.

Explanation and application

  • Apply shape border,fill and effects deliberately;too much shadow/glow can reduce readability.
  • Crop,resize and style pictures without changing factual meaning;provide alternative text when needed.
  • Older Office clip-art collections may be replaced by icons,stock or online images in modern versions.Use an approved equivalent and record licensing/source.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Drawing tools/stylesથી relationships સ્પષ્ટ કરો તથા image rights જાળવો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Border,fill/effects વિચારીને લો.વધુ shadow/glow readability ઘટાડે છે.
  • Factual meaning બદલ્યા વગર picture crop/resize/style કરો;જરૂર મુજબ alt text આપો.
  • જૂની clip-art collections modern versionsમાં icons,stock/online imagesથી replace થયેલી હોઈ શકે.Approved equivalent લો અને license/source લખો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Audio playback,object actions and slide transitions are different features;test them in slide-show mode.

Explanation and application

  • Insert licensed sample audio and choose permitted start/stop,volume and cross-slide playback settings;embed or package media as required.
  • Assigning sound to an object may use an action/animation trigger depending on the desktop version;document the available method rather than inventing a universal menu.
  • Transitions occur between slides;animations affect objects.Set duration/advance timing and verify manual versus automatic advance.
  • Run the presentation on the intended machine,check missing media,readability and accessible alternatives;do not assume editor preview proves playback.
Does Word SUM(ABOVE) behave exactly like Excel?

No.It is a Word field with its own reference/update behaviour.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Audio playback,object actions તથા slide transitions જુદા features છે.Slide-show modeમાં test કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Licensed sample audio લો તથા suitable start/stop,volume/cross-slide settings સેટ કરો.Jarur મુજબ media embed/package કરો.
  • Objectને sound assign કરવા version મુજબ action/animation trigger હોઈ શકે.Available method લખો,universal menu invent ન કરો.
  • Transitions slides વચ્ચે તથા animations objects ઉપર થાય છે.Duration/advance timing સેટ કરીને manual/automatic advance તપાસો.
